releases.release_notes_markdown:
### Features:
- Health Bar for level 4+ giants
- Ragdoll hit strength scales with size
### Bug fixes:
- Misc stuff that worked in offline mode but not in multiplayer:
  - `Leg Day` will be applied at lvl 3 as intended (previously only the Meteor ability enabled jumps)
  - `Squish`  and `Living Meteor` Audio SFX
- Changed the way scaling is applied:
  - fixes glitchy animation when running/jumping (excessive jitter)
  - players should be less likely to get stuck
  - Allows picking up small object with the "crotch cam" (lvl 4+)
  - Player size should no longer go out-of-sync when spawning far away or joining a game in progress
  - Improve hitbox accuracy
      - _There is still a dead zone around giant characters where kicks/jabs/squishes are more effective_
  - Kick/Jab targeting will be more reliable for giants
  - `Squish`: effective radius has been reduced (:soon:: knockback effect on players in range)
  - Fixed an issue where giants could crush smaller players by walking
### Other Changes:
- `Living Meteor` sets the user on fire and deals damage (100 per use)
  - Double jumping (Jump + Living meteor) may hurt you
- Jump "ballistic" momentum will only apply to `Living Meteor` now
- Exposed more variables to config file

releases.release_notes_markdown:
## Levels
Your scale roughly represents your level. As you grow, you unlock new abilities:
- Super Kick/Jab: More powerful versions. Unlocked at level 2
- Squash: Landing on your enemies' heads kills them. Unlocked at level 3
- Living Meteor: Replaces your special ability. Sets players ablaze and knocks them up in the air. Unlocked at level 4
